brute_creator.m:
Oh, a visitor. How unusual.
Come in, come in. I am Os.
r: Hi, I am $playername. Glad to meet you.

brute_creator_10.m: Here in my laboratory you can see the latest research on brutes.

brute_creator_2.m: You certainly want to know everything about these brutes outside.

brute_creator_20.m: Exploring? Well, no. I am far more gone already.

brute_creator_22.m: 'Creating' fits better. Best I'll show you.

brute_creator_24.m: Of course I can't explain too much to you. Otherwise my ideas would soon be stolen.
r: Do I look like a thief?
Do I look like a thief?

brute_creator_28.m: Indeed no. But better safe than sorry.

brute_creator_30.m: I'll just say that my brutes evolve from rats. There are too many of them anyway.

brute_creator_32.m: This was a triumph, a huge success!
r: Thank you for telling me all this.

brute_creator_4.m: Indeed. And you are talking to the leading expert in these matters who is still alive.
r: These 'matters' tend to run around and get in my way.

brute_creator_40.m: Now I have to work again.
r: Be glad. May I visit your laboratory?

brute_creator_42.m: You're welcome to look around a little. But don't enter the Brute Bake rooms.
r: Sure, I want to stay alive after all.

brute_creator_6.m: Yes, they love to do so. Aren't they adorable?

brute_creator.10: I have met Bidro, a fisherman on the long way to Remgard. He wondered why only few people come along nowadays.
brute_creator.20: I told Bidro about the many nasty monsters along the way.
brute_creator.30: I have discovered a cave where brutes seem to pour out.
brute_creator.35: Then I have told Bidro about this cave full of brutes.
brute_creator.40: I have talked to Os, a scientist about brute matters. He has built up a brute production facility.
brute_creator.90: I told Bidro what I have learned from Os. He thanked me for this new story he could tell his wife.

farrik.10: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me of a plan to help a fellow thief escape from the Fallhaven jail.
farrik.20: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me the details of the plan, and I accepted the task of helping him. The guard captain apparently has a drinking problem. The plan is that I get a prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild that will knock out the guard captain in the jail. I might be required to bribe the guard captain.
farrik.25: I got the prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.30: I told Farrik that I don't fully agree with their plan. I might tell the guard captain about their shady plan.
farrik.32: I have given the prepared mead to the guard captain.
farrik.40: I have told the guard captain of the plan that the thieves have to release their friend.
farrik.50: The guard captain wants me to tell the thieves that the security will be lowered for tonight. We might be able to catch some of the thieves.
farrik.60: I managed to bribe the guard captain into drinking the prepared mead. He should be out during the night allowing the thieves to break their friend free.
farrik.70: Farrik rewarded me for helping the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.80: I have told Farrik that the security will be lowered tonight.
farrik.90: The guard captain thanked me for helping him plan to catch the thieves. He said he will also tell other guards that I helped him.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
